Add an Entry to the lib-* Library from a DOI

Source: R/rProject-lib-add.R
LibAdd.Rd

Drafts a biblatex entry from the DOI's Crossref record, in the house layout, and names the repository and file it belongs in:

Usage

LibAdd(doi, root, key = NULL, title = NULL, fields = NULL, write = FALSE)

Arguments

doi

Character string. The DOI.

root

Character string. The folder with local clones of the lib-* projects.

key

Character string or NULL. A key to use instead of the drafted one (e.g., with a suffix).

title

Character string or NULL. A title to use instead of the drafted one.

fields

Named character vector or NULL. Fields to set or replace (e.g., full author names or an abstract from the publisher's page).

write

Logical. If TRUE, write the file and run LibCheck() on its repository.

Value

Returns a list with file, text, and questions, invisibly.

Details

  • the entry type and the repository type from the Crossref type;

  • date from the print issue (published-print), else the journal issue, else the first publication; the key year and the decade repository follow it;

  • names and text with LaTeX accents, and \% and \& escaped;

  • the key as Family-Family-Family[-etal]-Year, accents dropped;

  • the abstract without its JATS tags;

  • the ISSN and publisher reused from the library's other entries for the same journal;

  • the title in a sentence-case draft.

It never invents a field: what Crossref does not have is left out. It lists what it cannot decide (initials only, an online-first date, a missing abstract, the title's proper nouns, a key already in use) as questions for the user.
